item: Kernel and journal lines the diagnostics report quotes are checked whole for the passphrase before they leave the reader
summary: The standalone session-forensics route and its text download quoted OS-written journal and kernel lines (an audit record carries a process argv) with no net; only the bundle member had one. published_lines() picks the last N whole lines and checks each; classification still reads the lines as written. Three sites (journal, kern.log fallback, user-space killers), each with a test that fails when the check goes.
